$comment: Release manifest for moving OPC Foundation review drafts between marcschier/opcua-drafts and OPCF-Members/spec-drafts. Each release unit names its current source/, model/, extras/, and retained Word artifacts; closure, vendoring, aggregate validators, public holdbacks, and reverse references are explicit rather than inferred from directory scans.

avro-encoding.$comment: Releasable. Tooling imports shared _common and validate_local.py invokes build_schemas.py with no arguments, so the default Observability Export NodeSet is a runtime dependency. The public Arrow tooling consumes the byte-identical fixture under shared _common; private Avro consumes the reviewed model in spec-drafts.
avro-encoding.title: OPC UA — Apache Avro DataEncoding

data-channels.$comment: Releasable base-namespace errata package. The combined specification, the insertion-ready Part 3, Part 4 and Part 6 errata, the generated model, the wire tooling, and the linked informative throughput report form one review unit. Both validators are self-contained and the draft has no RequiredModel dependency, so it needs neither closure nor vendored specifications.
data-channels.title: OPC UA — Data Channels

observability-export.$comment: Releasable Observability Export companion specification. Its normative NodeSet has one authoritative review copy; the public repository carries a byte-identical fixture under shared tooling for self-contained generator validation.
observability-export.title: OPC UA — Observability Export

openusd-binding.$comment: Releasable OpenUSD Part 1. xRegistry is vendored because the private OPC UA model requires it. The independent OpenUSD Artifact Registry domain specification and model are maintained upstream by xregistry/spec and are referenced there rather than duplicated in either draft repository.
openusd-binding.title: OPC UA for OpenUSD — Part 1: OpenUSD Binding

openusd-scene.$comment: Releasable OpenUSD Part 2. Its NodeSet is self-contained on base OPC UA, but its example regeneration and round-trip tooling read Part 1 example USDA assets, so Part 1 is in the release closure.
openusd-scene.title: OPC UA for OpenUSD — Part 2: Scene Materialization

wot-binding.$comment: Releasable WoT vocabulary/binding specification. It has no NodeSet RequiredModel and its validator is local to wot-specs/WoT-Binding. extras/wot-specs/WoT-Binding holds the informative crosswalk that supports this draft and links into it, so it travels with the specification like every other extras mirror.
wot-binding.title: OPC UA — Web of Things Binding

wot-connectivity.$comment: Releasable WoT Connectivity revision. WoT Binding is in closure because it is part of the OPC Foundation WoT submission. xRegistry is vendored, not closed over: the private export needs the base NodeSet/CSV and word spec so RequiredModel and validators resolve, but xRegistry stays public because it is a shared base for other public specs and has a public xregistry.org proposal.
wot-connectivity.title: OPC UA — WoT Connectivity

xregistry.$comment: Releasable abstract registry base model. The public redirect README is outside the moved source/model/extras paths and remains public automatically. Public specifications consume the released NodeSet from model/dependencies.
xregistry.title: OPC UA — xRegistry
